## 6. Power Skips (for distance)

Exercise Objective: Develop explosive power in the lower body

## Procedure

1. Perform a high skip by driving the left knee forward and upward, maintaining a 90° angle at the knee, landing on the take-off leg (the extended leg)
2. Try to attain maximal distance during every skip (-17)
3. Drive arms aggressively in opposition to the legs

## Coaching Points

- The take-off leg should reach full extension at the ankle, knee, and hip for every skip
- The goal should be to skip as far as possible, not as high as possible
